name: @nube/starter-ui-sdui-native
description: React Native SDUI renderers. Side-effect barrel that registers one renderer per IR Kind into the shared `registerRenderer` registry exported by `@nube/starter-ui-sdui-react/headless`. Each renderer imports only `@nube/starter-ui-kit-native` + `@nube/starter-ui-ir` types — no direct react-native primitives, no `@nube/starter-ui-kit` (web) imports. Mirrors the 16 kinds the web renderer covers; the remaining 10 IR kinds are deferred-with-web (see README).
